name: Google Workspace Studio
description: Google Workspace Studio is Google's no-code, AI-powered workflow builder for Google Workspace — connect Gmail, Chat, Drive, Docs, Sheets, and Calendar with triggers, actions, and Gemini-powered AI decision steps to automate real work. It shipped in alpha as "Google Workspace Flows" and is now generally available on Business and Enterprise Workspace plans.

writing-chat.summary: Studio is a workflow builder, not a chat assistant, but Gemini-powered natural-language input helps describe and generate a flow's steps, and AI steps within a flow can draft chat-style replies (e.g. an email draft) as part of automation.

subFeatures.name: Describe-a-Flow Assist
subFeatures.description: Describe the automation you want in plain language and Studio proposes the trigger/action steps to build it

subFeatures.name: AI Draft Steps
subFeatures.description: An AI step inside a flow can draft a reply or message as part of the automated sequence

limitations: Not a general-purpose conversational assistant — chat-style output only occurs as a step inside a workflow
Flow-generation assist is scoped to what Studio's step types support

pricingTiers.details: Describe-a-flow assist and AI draft steps included with Studio access

versionHistory.changes: Renamed from 'Google Workspace Flows' (alpha) to Google Workspace Studio at general availability on Business and Enterprise Workspace plans
Announced in alpha as a no-code, Gemini-powered workflow builder connecting Gmail, Chat, Drive, and Docs

research.summary: Studio automates workflows across Workspace apps; it does not perform open-web research or cite external sources.

subFeatures.name: Not Available
subFeatures.description: Studio's AI steps reason over the data passed into the flow (e.g. an email's contents), not the open web

limitations: No built-in web search or citation feature
External data must come from a connected Workspace app or an added integration

file-analysis.summary: AI steps in a Studio flow can read and reason over the content of an incoming email, a Doc, or a Sheet row to decide what happens next — e.g. categorizing an email or extracting a meeting's date and attendees.

subFeatures.name: AI Categorize Step
subFeatures.description: Reads an incoming item (e.g. an email) and sorts it into categories to route the flow

subFeatures.name: Field Extraction
subFeatures.description: Pulls structured details (date, time, attendees) out of an email or document to feed a later step

limitations: Analysis is scoped to the data a given step is wired to receive
Not a general-purpose document Q&A tool outside a flow

pricingTiers.details: AI categorize and extraction steps included with Studio access

versionHistory.changes: AI file/content analysis steps available at general availability

document-creation.summary: A Studio flow can create and update content in Workspace apps as an action — for example logging a new row to a Sheet or creating a Calendar event — as part of an automated sequence.

subFeatures.name: Log-to-Sheet Action
subFeatures.description: Appends a new row (e.g. date, sender, category, action taken) to a Google Sheet as a flow step

subFeatures.name: Create-Calendar-Event Action
subFeatures.description: Creates a Calendar event with extracted date, time, and attendees as a flow step

limitations: Document/record creation is limited to the action types Studio supports for each connected app
Not a standalone document editor — creation only happens as part of a running flow

pricingTiers.details: Sheet, Docs, and Calendar creation/update actions included with Studio access

versionHistory.changes: Cross-app document/record creation actions available at general availability

image-generation.summary: Studio automates workflows across Workspace apps and does not generate images.

subFeatures.name: Not Available
subFeatures.description: No image generation step type exists in Studio

limitations: No image generation capability
No integration with an image generation model as a flow step

prototyping.summary: Studio builds no-code automation flows, not software prototypes — there is no code editor, execution sandbox, or app scaffolding.

subFeatures.name: Not Available
subFeatures.description: Studio is for wiring existing Workspace apps together, not building new software

limitations: No code execution or app scaffolding
Not designed for software development workflows

personalization.summary: Each flow is built and owned by its creator (or shared within an org), with its own triggers, actions, and step-level instructions — so automation behavior is personalized per flow rather than via account-wide assistant settings.

subFeatures.name: Per-Flow Configuration
subFeatures.description: Each flow's triggers, branches, and AI-step instructions are configured individually by its owner

limitations: No persona or account-wide assistant customization — personalization lives inside each flow's own setup
Sharing/editing permissions follow the organization's Workspace admin settings

pricingTiers.details: Per-flow configuration included with Studio access

versionHistory.changes: Per-flow configuration available at general availability

persistent-context.summary: A published flow keeps running on its trigger indefinitely, and each run is logged, so context and history persist across every execution without the user re-setting anything up.

subFeatures.name: Always-On Flows
subFeatures.description: Once published, a flow keeps running on its trigger (e.g. every new email) until paused or edited

subFeatures.name: Run History/Logs
subFeatures.description: Each run's outcome (e.g. a logged Sheet row) provides a persistent record across executions

limitations: Persistence is scoped to a given flow's own run history, not a general cross-app memory
Editing a flow's logic applies going forward, not retroactively to past runs

pricingTiers.details: Always-on flows and run history included with Studio access

versionHistory.changes: Always-on flow execution and run logging available at general availability

agents.summary: Studio's defining capability is agentic workflow automation: AI steps make decisions on the user's behalf (e.g. categorizing an email and choosing which branch to run) with triggers, actions, and AI decisions all running unattended.

subFeatures.name: Trigger → Action Flows
subFeatures.description: A flow starts from a trigger (e.g. a new Gmail message) and runs a chain of actions automatically

subFeatures.name: AI Decision Branching
subFeatures.description: An AI step evaluates the incoming item and picks which branch of the flow runs next, without a human in the loop

limitations: Agentic decisions are scoped to the categories/branches defined when the flow was built
Complex or ambiguous cases may still need a human-reviewed fallback branch

pricingTiers.details: Trigger/action flows and AI decision steps included with Studio access

versionHistory.changes: Renamed from 'Google Workspace Flows' (alpha) to Google Workspace Studio at general availability; core agentic trigger/action/AI-decision model unchanged
Alpha release of the no-code AI workflow builder with trigger/action/AI-decision flows

connectors.summary: Studio's core value is connecting the Workspace apps people already use every day — Gmail, Calendar, Drive, Docs, Sheets, and Chat — as triggers and actions inside a single flow.

subFeatures.name: Gmail/Calendar/Drive/Docs/Sheets Triggers and Actions
subFeatures.description: Native triggers (e.g. new email) and actions (e.g. create event, append row, update doc) across core Workspace apps

subFeatures.name: Chat Integration
subFeatures.description: Flows can post to or trigger from Google Chat as part of an automation

limitations: Connector set is limited to Workspace apps Studio supports, not arbitrary third-party APIs out of the box
Only available on Business and Enterprise Workspace plans — not Workspace Individual or Business Starter

pricingTiers.details: Gmail, Calendar, Drive, Docs, Sheets, and Chat connectors included

versionHistory.changes: General availability on Business and Enterprise Workspace plans

dictation.summary: Studio is a web-based flow builder; it does not offer voice input or dictation.

subFeatures.name: Not Available
subFeatures.description: Flows are built and configured through the web interface, not voice

limitations: No voice input or dictation support
No speech-to-text capability
